dedupe_keys.name: oe7 consumo de energia electrica domestica

description: OE7 Consumo de energía eléctrica doméstica is a dataset listed in Valencia open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de València. Consumo de energía. Coverage: Valencia. The portal files it under Environment. The portal shows 15 records. The portal shows 2023-01-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Caveats: the current city indicator page and matching indicator source were checked on 2026-10-08; its linked source CSV returned HTTP 200 to HEAD. The CSV was not downloaded, so its data values and full temporal coverage were not checked. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-valencia-portal.
